rows.en: Infiltrate Jaburo
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Escort the target
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Find the hidden passage
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: We are now<pt(0,-18.75,0,2)> heading for <pic(0)><cs(3)>Jaburo<ce()>, but it is not responding to our calls.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: It's not because we're defectors, it seems. All comm lines have been completely cut.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: The E2 is currently being stored at Jaburo.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: If an enemy has attacked it... then this is clearly an emergency.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: We may be at odds with them now, but they were once our allies.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: <mk(-75,50,1,0,50)><ar(0,1,0,200)>We will head out at once to support the UCE. This is also Miss Relena's wish.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: If it is an enemy, then it has enough strength to push into Jaburo. Be extremely careful.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Jaburo collapsed completely in the explosion of the E2.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: The E2 is gone from this world... But that alone won't be the end of it.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: Dermail seems to have started moving to retaliate against Char Aznable's <cs(1)>Neo Zeon<ce()>.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: The UCE's own leaders have gathered at its space base, the Gate of Zedan, massing forces.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: All-out war preparations are steadily advancing. At this rate, it will all happen again.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: Having lost her chance to persuade the UCE at Jaburo, Miss Relena ignored our protests
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: and set off for the Gate of Zedan.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: She means to stop a reckless act of retaliation, but it is far too dangerous.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: I want you all there at once as well. Stop the pointless fighting, whatever it takes.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: We can't stand still if we want peace. Don't let your guard down, even for an instant.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)
